parties: BIL VYAPAR LIMITED (Corporate Debtor); Committee of Creditors (CoC); Insolvency Professional
headline: BIL Vyapar Limited CoC holds 19th meeting; outcome filed with NSE
sum: BIL Vyapar Limited reported the outcome of its 19th Committee of Creditors meeting to the NSE, marking a significant milestone in its ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The filing does not disclose the specific resolution or decision taken at the meeting.
implication: Active CIRP milestones (CoC meetings reaching 19 rounds) signal prolonged resolution timelines; transactional counsel should monitor eventual approval of resolution plans or insolvency professional recommendations under IBC §30–31.
detail: BIL Vyapar Limited, listed on the NSE, has filed formal disclosure of the 19th Committee of Creditors meeting held on 14 August 2026 under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC). The CoC meeting is a mandatory forum under IBC §21 where creditors vote on the approval of resolution plans or other material decisions in the CIRP. The NSE filing constitutes regulatory disclosure of this corporate action. The substance of the outcome (e.g., resolution plan approval, extension of timeline, or further proceedings) is not detailed in the header document available.
